# Jeep Insurance

## About
Jeep Insurance (jeepinsurance.co) is a specialty insurance agency focused on commercial Jeep and off-road tour, rental, and event operators — guided Jeep tours, Jeep and 4x4 rental fleets, Jeep outfitters, and off-road club and trail-ride event organizers. This is commercial coverage for the business, not personal Jeep insurance. A division of Contractors Choice Agency, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states since 2005.

## Services
- General Liability Insurance: Third-party and bystander bodily injury and property damage arising from your tour and rental operation at the staging area, office, and trailhead.
- Participant Accident Insurance: Medical coverage for tour passengers and rental riders injured during your activity — the rollover and trail-accident exposure general liability excludes.
- Rental Fleet Physical Damage: Physical-damage coverage for the Jeep and 4x4 fleet — rollovers, trail damage, theft, and renter-caused damage; off-road use that standard auto policies exclude.
- Abuse & Molestation Liability Insurance: Essential when serving minors, families, and youth groups; covers abuse/molestation and negligent hiring/supervision/retention claims that standard GL excludes.
- Commercial Auto Insurance: On-road tour and shuttle vehicles plus the trucks and trailers that haul the fleet.
- Special Event Liability Insurance: Coverage for organized trail rides, 4x4 events, and club gatherings — spectator and participant exposure, with venue/land-manager additional insured.
- Workers Compensation Insurance: Medical bills and lost wages when guides, drivers, mechanics, or staff are injured on the job.

## Target Audience
Commercial Jeep and off-road tour operators, Jeep and 4x4 rental fleet operators, Jeep outfitters, and off-road club and trail-ride event organizers.
